newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Cross-Continent starts as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Cross-Continent starts as buy.

text.p: --ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Cross-Continent Auto Retailers Inc with a buy rating and a six-to-12-month price target of $28.

--Its earnings-per-share estimate on the company, which completed its initial public offering September 23, 1996, is for $0.14 in the 1996 Q4 and $0.44 for all of 1996. For 1997, its EPS estimate is $0.92.
--Cross-Continent, an auto dealership company, traded at 23-1/4, up 1/8.
